solution.text: <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup></math>  is a strong field ligand so greater the number of  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup></math> , more will be the strength of ligands and more will be the value of  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mrow></msub></math>  (crystal field splitting energy).
